known_limits: deterministic extraction only - no model-based summarization
recent turns limited to 20 in canonical state
artifact content not stored - only references
compaction drops oldest non-system messages first
streaming commits user+assistant turn on complete or user-only on error
no automatic summarization of older history
single-writer SQLite - not suited for multi-process deployments without WAL
per-conversation lock granularity not implemented (single global RLock)
multi-process safety not proven (in-process RLock only)
